name: Starry Excavator
name_jp: 極星エクスカベーター
effects:
Grants Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Diffusion Barrier 1 to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Fire/NE, Earth/NE, Wind/NE or Poison/NE ranged physical attacks + minor DeProtect for 5 seconds under En-Fire, En-Earth, En-Wind or En-Poison, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison/NE ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1 + DeProtect 30% for 5 seconds, Instant Cast 1 to user, removes Master Mode
